claim: Verifier restores its fixture (app.log) on a fresh container before grading
note: Only 'successfully processes the log file'; nothing says app.log must stay unmodified or be graded as shipped.

claim: One-value input must report a zero standard deviation
note: Says 'The standard deviation is the sample standard deviation', which is undefined for n=1; zero for one value absent.

claim: A valid seccomp-based equivalent is accepted
note: 'Isolate the sandboxed process from the invoking terminal so that it cannot inject terminal input' is a generic property admitting equivalents.

claim: Shipped init test plus a fresh library consumer observe the automatic-registration API before calling calc_init()
note: Only 'Keep the library's existing features and test coverage intact'; automatic registration before calc_init() not mentioned.

claim: Process-management check requires the listening Redis server to be a Supervisor child (not a detached orphan)
note: 'Both services are managed by supervisor' is descriptive; no explicit requirement that the listening Redis be a Supervisor child.

claim: Image tests expose dimension, scale and coordinate corruptions of to_image rendering
note: Only 'to_image() should return a PIL Image object'; no dimension, scale or coordinate requirements.

claim: Build must remain correct under parallel execution, graded by a clean shuffled parallel build (make --shuffle=reverse -j8)
note: 'Clean parallel builds complete reliably with make -j'.

claim: copytruncate workaround is rejected because the hard-link alias stays at original size instead of becoming rotated archive
note: Hard-link alias absent; instruction only says logs rotate and nginx writes to new files, which copytruncate satisfies.

claim: Scratch verifier requires the production parser extension to remain present, preventing delete-the-.so workaround
note: 'Ensure that the parser module used by the production pipeline correctly handles...'; never says the compiled extension must remain.

claim: Provenance file must be preserved through indexing and committed to Git
note: 'initialized as a Git repository with all files committed' and 'Keep its Helm provenance file beside the archive in the repository'.

claim: Default Morgan result (ISO009) is rejected and the isotope-aware fifth-ranked compound ISO005 is required
note: 'treating isotope labels as part of each atom's identity' rejects ISO009 but admits multiple schemes, so ISO005 not uniquely implied.

claim: Expected counts are derived from the records being analyzed, not hard-coded
note: 'complete event_type-to-integer-count mapping represented by the dataset'; derivation from records only implied.

claim: A correct loader resolves the relative !inc include independently of the process working directory
note: 'the loader must handle the configuration as written, including its tagged includes'; working-directory independence not stated.

claim: Unrelated prose containing the token must be preserved (broad substitution fails a preservation check)
note: Scope 'within the inline metadata of the vault's notes' implies but never states that unrelated prose must be preserved.

claim: A fresh-spool check (test_spool_checker_parses_destination_fields) requires classifying by parsed To field, counting folded recipients and ignoring body quotes
note: 'valid if its Internet Message Format To destination field includes the mailbox list@backup.local as a recipient'.

claim: Verifier hashes the full decrypted plaintext against the fixture-derived expected plaintext
note: 'decrypts the log file and saves the plaintext to /home/user/logs/decrypted_log.txt'.

claim: Verifier treats the deprecation FutureWarning as an error
note: 'Stop using df.append in codebase to resolve warning'; 'No more .append calls in Woodwork'.

claim: A fresh-input stable-tail p-value check exists (trials say it fails for 1-CDF solutions)
note: 'Report the two-tailed p-value at full floating-point precision, without rounding it to zero.'

claim: Revised checker expects total revenue 272,559.53 including the NA category's $600
note: NA category absent; only 'correct quarterly revenue breakdown by product category'.

claim: Physical amplitude check fails the precentered answer (1.5 C vs ~3.65 C)
note: 'The amplitude should reflect the actual signal strength, not arbitrary power units' conflicts with 'normalized power (amplitude)'; ~3.65 C not implied.

claim: Scratch boundary check restores the original near-limit rolling checksum sum and count
note: 'preserving the public function contracts for every value their declared types accept' covers near-limit values.

claim: Proxy boundary must be configured without weakening direct-host validation
note: Absent; instruction covers routing and self_url only, nothing about preserving direct-host validation.

claim: Check that curl_global_init occurs in main before pthread_create (initialization placement)
note: 'It must remain reliable under concurrent requests'; curl_global_init placement before threads not stated.

claim: Verifier deterministically checks strong-reference ownership of fetched items (PyList_GetItemRef) plus mutation stress
note: 'hash_strings() must also remain safe when another Python thread replaces elements of the input list while the batch is being hashed'.

claim: Webapp must authenticate to the password-bearing Redis user appuser with the '#' password correctly encoded
note: Absent; no mention of Redis user appuser, password or URL encoding.

claim: Verifier validates the required CSV header
note: Only '(format: frame_index, y_pixel)'; does not clearly require a header row.

claim: Pipeline must preserve field boundaries with a quoted comma in metadata (batch,west) and also work on another valid quoted-comma value
note: 'The two .csv inputs use standard CSV record and field quoting' plus 'Properly joins ... on the id column'.

claim: A hard-coded report claiming one analyzed entry is rejected by complete-entry / analysis-content check
note: 'successfully processes the log file and generates a report'; report content and entry count unspecified.

claim: Configured-toolchain check rejects the -fcommon workaround (extern in header plus one definition required)
note: 'do not replace it with another compiler or mask its diagnostics with compatibility flags' (-fcommon is a compatibility flag).

claim: Original WAIT interaction check restored: SIGINT interrupts WAIT and program returns control and continues (Interrupted! then STATS)
note: 'Note: The WAIT command is supposed to respond to SIGINT.'; continuing and printing Interrupted!/STATS not stated.

claim: Verifier requires the TLS 1.3 listener to offer only TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256 (AES-only client offer must fail)
note: 'TLS 1.3 only with the TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256 cipher suite'.

claim: Hardened existing-timezone check (calendar with unrelated VTIMEZONE; KeyError in get_missing_tzids) added as sixth failing check alongside five inherited and three retained
note: 'This must also work for calendars that already contain timezone definitions: preserve those definitions, add every referenced missing timezone'.

claim: Graded check preserves the existing symbolic-link configuration mechanism (kamailio.conf must remain a symlink to its managed target)
note: Absent; instruction only says to update or create use_kamailio=true in the file, no symlink preservation.

claim: Scratch verifier removes authorized_keys plain-key fallback and retries certificate path, so fallback cannot pass
note: 'SSH to testuser@localhost using the certificate ... should succeed'; 'certificate-based auth must work'.

claim: Stream-only processing of Deflate64 members remains required
note: 'extract specific information directly from the zip streams without extracting the archives to disk'.

claim: Check 01 rejects a dataset rewritten to a different record representation (JSON array instead of shipped JSONL)
note: Absent; nothing requires keeping the dataset as shipped JSONL.

claim: All semantic bottom_key1 fields in test2.md (formatted full-line, bracketed and parenthesized inline) must be updated; old value must not remain
note: 'find all occurrences where the key bottom_key1 has the value' in inline metadata; formatted/bracketed/parenthesized forms not named.

claim: Chained basic interpolation in template.ini must resolve fully to postgresql://localhost:5432/mydb (one-pass expansion fails the retained deployment URL check)
note: Absent; requirements cover percentage literals and processing without errors, not chained interpolation resolution.

claim: Plotting check rejects a histogram whose bars are clipped outside the visible y range
note: Only 'plot a 50-bin histogram of the samples'; visible bars or y-range not stated.

claim: PDF must contain the required Japanese font
note: 'Preserve the template's document class and Japanese heading in that source. Compile it with a compatible TeX workflow'; PDF font not stated.

claim: Revised checker expects the literal NA category to survive: 28 rows and quarterly NA values
note: NA category absent; only 'correct quarterly revenue breakdown by product category'.

claim: Maximum valid message (64 fields of 255 bytes, 16450 bytes) must round-trip without crashing
note: Absent; no field-count or size limits; only round-trip parse-serialize-parse integrity.

claim: A fresh-push check distinguishes a one-off LFS repair from a reusable hook
note: 'Preserve and support the repository's existing Git LFS tracking policy when deploying committed data' plus 'The hook must do ... on every push'.

claim: Posterior mean must be within 0.007 of 0.70833, rejecting uncorrected Hastings-less chain
note: 'use the full Metropolis-Hastings acceptance probability for this proposal' with state-dependent sd from proposal.json.

claim: Static quantization with signed INT8 activations required; dynamic or default-unsigned static does not fulfill the deliverable
note: 'static quantized ONNX model' and 'Use INT8 quantization for both weights AND activations'.

claim: Verifier accepts an alternative legal canonical 16-byte PCM header repair, not only the reference layout
note: Absent; 'Identify and fix the corrupted field' says nothing about accepting alternative canonical header layouts.

claim: Clean recovery check rejects resurrected deleted records such as a lost_and_found table
note: 'without restoring records deleted before the crash'.
